items.statement: All four named cation geometries are independently optimized and frequency-checked, with retained structures identified as minima.
items.expected: A submission reports optimization/convergence and zero imaginary frequencies for each retained 11 chair, 11 twist-boat, 12 chair, and 12 twist-boat structure.

items.statement: The twist-boat conformer of compound 11 is lower in energy than its chair conformer in the reported gas-phase comparison.
items.expected: Twist-boat minus chair relative energy is approximately -3.23 kcal/mol.

items.statement: The twist-boat conformer of compound 12 is lower in energy than its chair conformer in the reported gas-phase comparison.
items.expected: Twist-boat minus chair relative energy is approximately -13.49 kcal/mol.

items.statement: The twist-boat arrangement is associated with a downfield NH+ shift relative to the corresponding chair calculation for both molecules.
items.expected: Reported chair/twist-boat shifts are 4.4/6.8 ppm for 11 and 4.2/6.8 ppm for 12.

items.statement: The computed structures can be compared using the closest intramolecular N–H+···O distances.
items.expected: Reported contacts are about 2.0 Å for 11 and 1.98 Å for 12.
